title.en: “Static Pressure in a Fluid” leaves Both print 12–15 m³/h on the Electric 30 Concrete Pump row
title.zh: 「静压 在 流体」不改共享的 1200 kg 外形仍然要在 30 kW 和 37 kW 之间选择这一行里的「在这一对里是电动低压40。」

description.en: Electric 30 Concrete Pump at /products/electric-30-concrete-pump. Both print 12–15 m³/h Electric 30’s list used here does not
description.zh: 共享的 1200 kg 外形仍然要在 30 kW 和 37 kW 之间选择见 /products/electric-30-concrete-pump。在这一对里是电动低压40。此处使用的电动30列表没有。

h1.en: Static Pressure in a Fluid does not retitle the Electric 30 Concrete Pump cells
h1.zh: 「静压 在 流体」并不改写共享的 1200 kg 外形仍然要在 30 kW 和 37 kW 之间选择的格子

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints the figures for Electric 30 Concrete Pump. The row to open is /products/electric-30-concrete-pump. Both print 12–15 m³/h. Electric 30’s list used here does not. Electric Low Pressure 40, on this pair. Electric 40 is 45 kW, 2300 kg and 3900 mm long. Diesel 30 also prints 20 MPa and is a third machine. Only Electric 30 prints the short aggregate-13 pair. Write 30 kW or 37 kW in the first line with the path. Ordering “12–15” without the row still leaves two pages. Name the kilowatts and whether you need the aggregate-13 row. A frame of 3300 × 1500 × 1500 mm and 1200 kg is printed twice by Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. Electric Low Pressure 40 is 37 kW, 12–15 m³/h, 20 MPa, hopper 0.3 m³, one fine-stone pair at 80 m / 240 m and Kawasaki 112. Electric 30 is a 30 kW motor, 12–15 m³/h, 20 MPa, hopper 0.3 m³, fine-stone 60 m / 180 m, aggregate-13 20 m / 60 m and aggregate ≤ 3 cm. The section title “Specific Weight” comes from the source page and does not add a rating. No price is printed on the product page.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台印出的是共享的 1200 kg 外形仍然要在 30 kW 和 37 kW 之间选择的数字。要打开的行是 /products/electric-30-concrete-pump。在这一对里是电动低压40。此处使用的电动30列表没有。两者都印 12–15 m³/h。只有电动30印了较短的 13 骨料组。只写“12–15”而不写行，仍然是两页。请写明千瓦，以及你是否需要 13 骨料行。柴油30也印 20 MPa，那是第三台机器。第一行写 30 kW 或 37 kW，并附路径。电动40是 45 kW、2300 kg、长 3900 mm。外形 3300 × 1500 × 1500 mm 和 1200 kg 被河北品锦机械（邢台）印了两次。电动低压40是 37 kW、12–15 m³/h、20 MPa、料斗 0.3 m³、一组细石 80 m / 240 m、川崎 112。电动30是 30 kW 电机、12–15 m³/h、20 MPa、料斗 0.3 m³、细石 60 m / 180 m、13 骨料 20 m / 60 m、骨料 ≤ 3 cm。节标题「重度」来自来源页，不另加额定值。产品页没有印价格。

body.en: For Electric 30 Concrete Pump, the heading “Specific Weight” does not replace a cell. Both print 12–15 m³/h. Electric 40 is 45 kW, 2300 kg and 3900 mm long. Write 30 kW or 37 kW in the first line with the path. A frame of 3300 × 1500 × 1500 mm and 1200 kg is printed twice by Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai.
body.zh: 对共享的 1200 kg 外形仍然要在 30 kW 和 37 kW 之间选择而言，标题「重度」并不替换任何格子。两者都印 12–15 m³/h。电动40是 45 kW、2300 kg、长 3900 mm。第一行写 30 kW 或 37 kW，并附路径。外形 3300 × 1500 × 1500 mm 和 1200 kg 被河北品锦机械（邢台）印了两次。

body.en: Electric 30 Concrete Pump is unchanged by the heading “Static Pressure in a Fluid”. Electric 30’s list used here does not. Diesel 30 also prints 20 MPa and is a third machine. Ordering “12–15” without the row still leaves two pages. Electric Low Pressure 40 is 37 kW, 12–15 m³/h, 20 MPa, hopper 0.3 m³, one fine-stone pair at 80 m / 240 m and Kawasaki 112.
body.zh: 共享的 1200 kg 外形仍然要在 30 kW 和 37 kW 之间选择不因标题「静压 在 流体」而改动。电动30是 30 kW 电机、12–15 m³/h、20 MPa、料斗 0.3 m³、细石 60 m / 180 m、13 骨料 20 m / 60 m、骨料 ≤ 3 cm。柴油30也印 20 MPa，那是第三台机器。只写“12–15”而不写行，仍然是两页。电动低压40是 37 kW、12–15 m³/h、20 MPa、料斗 0.3 m³、一组细石 80 m / 240 m、川崎 112。

body.en: This section is titled “Pressure vs. Head”. Electric 30 Concrete Pump still prints the cells below. Electric Low Pressure 40, on this pair. Only Electric 30 prints the short aggregate-13 pair. Name the kilowatts and whether you need the aggregate-13 row. Electric 30 is a 30 kW motor, 12–15 m³/h, 20 MPa, hopper 0.3 m³, fine-stone 60 m / 180 m, aggregate-13 20 m / 60 m and aggregate ≤ 3 cm. The photograph is an image from the source page https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/static-pressure-head-d_610.html.
body.zh: 本节标题是「压力与扬程」。共享的 1200 kg 外形仍然要在 30 kW 和 37 kW 之间选择下面这些格子仍是印出来的。在这一对里是电动低压40。只有电动30印了较短的 13 骨料组。请写明千瓦，以及你是否需要 13 骨料行。此处使用的电动30列表没有。配图来自来源页 https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/static-pressure-head-d_610.html。

question.en: Does “Specific Weight” replace Both print 12–15 m³/h?
question.zh: 「重度」会替换「在这一对里是电动低压40。」吗？

answer.en: No. Both print 12–15 m³/h remains the printed wording for Electric 30 Concrete Pump.
answer.zh: 不会。在这一对里是电动低压40。仍是共享的 1200 kg 外形仍然要在 30 kW 和 37 kW 之间选择已印的说法。

question.en: Where does Electric 30’s list used here does not belong on the Electric 30 Concrete Pump row?
question.zh: 共享的 1200 kg 外形仍然要在 30 kW 和 37 kW 之间选择这一行里，「此处使用的电动30列表没有。」放在哪里？

answer.en: It belongs on /products/electric-30-concrete-pump, beside the other printed cells, not under a guessed heading.
answer.zh: 它属于 /products/electric-30-concrete-pump，和其他已印格子在一起，不放到猜出来的标题下面。

question.en: What does “Static Pressure in a Fluid” add to Electric 30 Concrete Pump?
question.zh: 「静压 在 流体」给共享的 1200 kg 外形仍然要在 30 kW 和 37 kW 之间选择增加了什么？

answer.en: It is only the section title taken from https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/static-pressure-head-d_610.html. It does not add a performance figure.
answer.zh: 它只是取自 https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/static-pressure-head-d_610.html 的节标题，不增加性能数字。

question.en: Is a list price printed beside Both print 12–15 m³/h?
question.zh: 「在这一对里是电动低压40。」旁边印了标价吗？
